RFC2181-10.3-1.note: Re-judged 2026-09-30. TestRFC2181NSTargetIsNotAnAlias queries each NS target itself: a CNAME query returns no CNAME, an A query returns only A records owned by the target holding the configured addresses (an alias would answer a CNAME chain). Record: appendNS revert observed red. {single-polarity} holds: Ze serves no CNAME and no MX, so there is no alias to refuse.

RFC2181-10.3-2.note: TestRFC2181_NSCanonicalWithGlue asserts every synthesized NS target has an A record in the additional section of the same answer.

RFC2181-11-1.note: Re-judged 2026-09-30. Both sides of each bound: a 63-octet label accepted by parseConfig, a 255-octet name accepted by checkName and packed by the codec; a 64-octet label, an EMPTY label (the D-8 defect, fixed in checkName with the section 11 quote) and a 256-octet name refused, and the codec refuses 256. Records: checkName revert, both polarities observed red.

RFC2181-4.1-1.note: Re-judged 2026-10-15 (subagent, after 14d1c8f19c and 224b0ef514). The tagged unit changed only in its setup call: mgr.apply/applyListeners became reconcile(..., BindLenient), the policy the deleted wrappers passed; each unit binds one listener on a free port of a single loopback address (127.0.0.2 in TestRFC2181ReplySourcedFromTheQueriedAddress, 127.0.0.1 in TestRFC2181_UDPReplySourceAndPort), where lenient and strict bind alike, and every assertion line is byte-identical. Where this unit carries a revert record (TestDoTListener, TestDoHListener, TestRFC7858DoTNegotiatesOnlyBCP195Suites, the two RFC 2181 4.1-1 units), it was re-observed red today. Prior judgement re-read against the current body and stands: Re-judged 2026-09-30. TestRFC2181ReplySourcedFromTheQueriedAddress binds the listener to 127.0.0.2 and queries from 127.0.0.1, asserting reply source 127.0.0.2; a wildcard bind would source from 127.0.0.1, so the assertion discriminates (the earlier weak finding). Record: dnsserver Manager.bind revert observed red. {single-polarity} holds: every UDP listener binds one address and there is no explicit-source path to drive negatively.

RFC2181-4.2-2.note: Re-judged 2026-10-15 (subagent, after 14d1c8f19c and 224b0ef514). The tagged unit changed only in its setup call: mgr.apply/applyListeners became reconcile(..., BindLenient), the policy the deleted wrappers passed; the unit binds one free loopback port, where lenient and strict bind alike, and every assertion line is byte-identical. Where this unit carries a revert record (TestDoTListener, TestDoHListener, TestRFC7858DoTNegotiatesOnlyBCP195Suites, the two RFC 2181 4.1-1 units), it was re-observed red today. Prior judgement re-read against the current body and stands: TestRFC2181_UDPReplySourceAndPort reads the reply on the client's own ephemeral socket and matches the query id; a reply sent to any other destination port never arrives and the read fails.

RFC2181-5.2-1.note: TestRFC2181_RRSetEqualTTL drives answerQuestions for a three-address host and asserts every A record in the emitted RRSet carries the one configured TTL (120).

RFC2181-5.4-2.note: Re-judged 2026-10-12 (independent auditor). SHIFTED by 6e063fb498 (tests: give ten assert-nothing tests a real assertion), whose hunks sit in untagged sibling tests and the import block. The tagged unit is byte-identical (gate-verified) and no helper it calls changed. Verdict stands. Re-judged 2026-09-30. Positive: an overlapping response {B} replaces the cached A RRSet {A,B,C} with exactly {B}, so neither a union nor a remainder passes. Negative: the condition's false arm, data that forms no RRSet (AAAA of the same name, A of another name), leaves those sets whole. Records: cache.put reverts, both polarities observed red.

RFC2181-8-1.note: Re-judged 2026-09-30. Positive: parseTTL('0') is 0, and with default-ttl 2147483647 every A, NS and SOA record in the packed and re-read answer has the sign bit clear and value <= 2^31-1, closing the earlier 'when transmitted' gap. Negative: TestRFC2181_TTLSignBitBound refuses 2147483648 at the config boundary. Records: parseTTL revert, positive (author) and negative (judge) observed red.
